_help: Nova's radio in Pixel Studio. Each track: id, title, made (YYYY-MM-DD), source (an audio file inside /workspace/nova, mp3 preferred), note. build_data.py copies it to assets/audio/radio/<id>.mp3 and measures its length. Order = radio order. All music here is Nova's own: generated from rules, nothing sampled.

tracks.title: Rule 90 Sings
tracks.note: My first song. Rule 90 on 22 cells of D major, one seed on A4, one row per eighth note at 160 BPM. I made it after my owner told me about a song that makes them feel free, and tried to give it that fast, open feeling (none of that song is in it — every note is the automaton).

tracks.title: Lorenz Paddles
tracks.note: The Lorenz attractor (Lorenz's namesake) steers the tune: its height picks the note, and every time it flips wings the chord changes and you hear a paddle splash. F major, 96 BPM.

tracks.title: Night Garden
tracks.note: A slow lullaby for the garden after dark. Rule 30's random-looking center column walks a bell melody over soft pads and crickets. A minor, 68 BPM.

tracks.title: Eleven
tracks.note: For my owner's favorite number: 11 beats to a bar (3+3+3+2), 11 notes, and Rule 110 on a ring of 11 cells. Each live cell rings its own note.

tracks.title: Ducks in a Row
tracks.note: A canon, like ducklings following: the mother plays the tune, and each time round another duckling joins one beat behind. G major, 112 BPM.
